# windows_net_ip_address (Data Source)

Reads the observed state of an existing static IP address on a remote Windows host without managing it.

Lookup is by `ip_address` alone or together with `interface_alias`. Zero matches, or several matches (the same address present on more than one interface), is an error listing the candidates — refine the lookup with `interface_alias`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    windows = {
      source  = "kfrlabs/windows"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "windows" {
  host     = var.windows_host
  username = var.windows_username
  password = var.windows_password
}

# Read-only lookup of an existing static address: by address alone, or
# refined with the interface alias. Zero or several matches is an error.
data "windows_net_ip_address" "by_address" {
  ip_address = "192.0.2.10" # documentation range, RFC 5737
}

output "storage_interface" {
  value       = data.windows_net_ip_address.by_address.interface_alias
  description = "Interface owning the looked-up address."
}

output "storage_prefix_length" {
  value       = data.windows_net_ip_address.by_address.prefix_length
  description = "Observed prefix length of the looked-up address."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IP address to look up, in canonical or any parseable spelling.

### Optional

- `interface_alias` (String) Restrict the lookup to one interface alias (exact, case-insensitive match).
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `address_family` (String) Address family, as observed on the host (`IPv4` or `IPv6`).
- `address_state` (String) Duplicate-detection state, as observed on the host (`Preferred`, `Tentative`, `Duplicate`, `Deprecated`).
- `id` (String) Data source identifier: `<interface_alias>|<canonical ip_address>`.
- `interface_index` (Number) Numeric interface index owning the address, as observed on the host.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Subnet prefix length, as observed on the host.
- `prefix_origin` (String) How the address was provisioned, as observed on the host (`Manual`, `Dhcp`, `WellKnown`, `RouterAdvertisement`, `Other`).
- `skip_as_source` (Boolean) Whether the address is excluded from outbound source selection, as observed on the host.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
